data_validation.source_name: KPTCL daily load-curve reports, parsed by Vonter/kptcl-load-curve
data_validation.license: Open Database License (ODbL) 1.0; some contents copyright KPTCL. Raw file is not redistributed here.
data_validation.geographic_scope: Karnataka state grid (KPTCL). Not BESCOM feeder, transformer or apartment demand.
data_validation.timezone_assumption: Report clock times assumed to be IST (UTC+05:30); converted to UTC by subtracting 5h30m.
data_validation.duplicate_rule: When report hour 24 (day D) and hour 0 (day D+1) coincide, keep the hour-0 row.
data_validation.imputation: none; days with any missing hour are excluded from training/evaluation targets
data_validation.publication_lag: UNVALIDATED. Evaluation is a historical timestamp-split backtest.

split.rule: most recent usable complete IST days: 56 train / 14 validation / 14 test

input_availability: inputs use lags >= 48 h; training targets end before D-1

ridge.features: load lags 48/168/336 h, IST hour-of-day and day-of-week dummies

demo_date_rule: forecast_start = start of the final test day (predeclared, not chosen for performance)
note: Peak-hour overlap uses top-3 hours per day, ties broken by earliest start.
